assign.request: I want to explore color variations of all our UI. we have buttons, and tags, and cards, and the color permutations of stacking certain colors on certain colors (text color, pill color, card bg color, bg behind card color...). I don't think we've properly documented this. I want to lean into transparent black and white colors, so that they stack properly. there are many instances of buttons and pills on the site that have the same bg color, and you can't even see them.
assign.now: scoping - reading prior art (lew42.css ladder, imagine hover, Page card-frame, colstyles gaps)
steps: build the stack matrix page (live contrast annotations)
verify: 4 shots, counts agree, zero console errors

log.msg: prior art read. THE MECHANISM: framework.css .btn/button paints background: var(--surface) and .surface paints the same token, so every default button on a card is a zero-delta fill (only --line separates it). Same shape: code{--wash} on .wash, th{--tint} in a .tint panel.

local workarounds already exist and each is a point fix: blog.css .blog-chip went OUTLINED with the comment a fill reads as no chip at all; imagine.css hover uses color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent); Page.css column-row same. The alpha ladder is the general form of the fix they each found alone.

assign.now: designing the ladder - floors opaque, fills alpha; shade/paper literal rgba + fill = light-dark(shade,paper)

log.msg: matrix live, 72 cells x 2 modes. light-dark() VERIFIED: the SAME --fill-a08 reads rgba(0,0,0,0.08) in the light box and rgba(255,255,255,0.08) in the dark box on one page. 7 cells under the dL 3 bar today; alpha fixes 5.

WORSE than expected: lew42.css sets border:none on every button at (0,1,1), beating framework.css .btn,button border:1px solid var(--line) at (0,1,0). So a default button on a .surface card has NO fill delta AND NO hairline - dL 0.00, nothing. That is the owner complaint, measured.

five hand spot-checks agree with the page: shade-a08 on --wash 6.80, --surface button 2.4 on --tint, code alpha 14.3 via border, --bg on --wash 68.8 (hand 68.8 exact). Metric is max(fill, border, inset ring) dL* - the ring matters, framework.css added one to inline code for exactly this.
